meta.title: For schools
meta.description: How your school can take part in Friends of Animals competitions, step by step.

hero.title: Bring FOA to your school
hero.lead: Your students make art about animals. Your teachers run the first round. FOA provides the theme, the judging guide and a certificate for every participant.
hero.easy: Your class makes art about animals. The best work goes on to FOA.

items.title: Register your school
items.body: Tell us your school’s name, address and pin code, the principal’s and an authorised person’s contact details, and roughly how many students will take part. We aim to verify new schools within 2 working days.

items.title: Sign up for a competition
items.body: You get an institution ID, a registration reference and a coordinator dashboard. Schools can sign up as soon as a competition is announced, and register students once registration opens.

items.title: Hold the competition
items.body: We send the date, theme, permitted materials, time allowed, deadlines and how to submit. Hold it in school (essays and films can be done online). Your coordinator confirms it followed FOA’s guidelines.

items.title: Judge the first round
items.body: Appoint a small judging panel and use FOA’s judging guide. Name 1st, 2nd and 3rd for each category, and pick your shortlist for the next level.

items.title: Send your shortlist
items.body: Upload a clear photo or scan of each shortlisted entry. Once we verify an entry, courier the original artwork to FOA with the packing instructions and address we send.

coordinator.title: One teacher holds it together
coordinator.lead: Each school names a coordinator, usually a teacher. They:
items: register students and keep their details up to date
receive FOA’s messages and pass them on
confirm the competition and judging followed FOA’s guidelines
send the original artwork when we ask for it

items.title: Theme and rules
items.body: A theme about animals and kindness, age groups, permitted materials and clear deadlines.

items.title: A judging guide
items.body: The same criteria for every school, so the first round is fair and quick.

items.title: Certificates
items.body: A participation certificate for every student, and merit certificates for your school winners.

items.title: Packing and courier details
items.body: Instructions, the address and the deadline for sending original artwork.

items.title: A place on the path
items.body: Your shortlist goes on to FOA’s judges, and selected work can reach the public gallery.

items.title: Someone to ask
items.body: A help contact for every competition.

curriculum.title: This is work you already do
curriculum.lead: Kindness to animals is part of India’s national curriculum and education policy. An FOA competition gives your students a creative way to practise it.
curriculum.ncf: Foundational stage (ages 3 to 8): learning outcome C-4.6
curriculum.nep: National Education Policy 2020: the purpose of education

verma.lead: The idea of teaching our fundamental duties in school is not new.

contact.title: We encourage you to participate through your school.
contact.body: Ask a teacher or your principal to register your school. Students can also enter on their own if their school does not take part.
contact.openTitle: School registration opens with our first competition
contact.openBody: When the first competition is announced, this is where your school signs up. Until then, write to us and we will tell you when it opens.
